image_description: A low-angle, wide-shot photograph of an ornate Baroque-style church interior. The focal point is a high altar structure situated beneath a grand dome with frescoes and stained glass windows. The altar features a central tabernacle area, flanked by columns and decorative elements, with floral arrangements in the foreground. The architecture includes curved walls, pilasters, and elaborate moldings.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the image classifies correctly as an altar and not just a general church interior or stage set.
To verify the structural integrity of the complex Baroque architecture, ensuring columns and arches connect logically to the floor and ceiling without melting or floating.
To check for edge bleeding between the intricate altar carvings and the background, and to ensure floral arrangements do not fuse with the altar structure.
To assess overall sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle AI-generated noise or texture anomalies in the frescoed dome.

focus_areas: Structural connectivity of columns and arches in the background.
Clarity and separation of floral arrangements in the foreground.
Texture consistency of the marble/stone surfaces.
Geometric plausibility of the dome's perspective.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection of the altar structure with the floor and the background reredos. AI often struggles with the complex occlusion in Baroque interiors. Check if the floral arrangements have distinct stems or if they 'melt' into the altar front. Verify that the perspective lines of the architecture converge consistently.
